spots.name: Mount Adagdak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 610 m (2,001 ft).

spots.name: Adak Island
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 224 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L268250.

spots.name: Adak Island: Clam Lagoon

spots.name: Palisades Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
